result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best project management tool overall** if you're building a tech product. But the best choice depends on your team size, workflow, and whether you need product development, general task management, or company-wide operations.

My recommendation: don't choose the tool with the most features. Choose one your team will actually use every day.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning
- Fast, clean interface
- Great for engineering and product teams
- Integrates with GitHub and Slack

Website: [Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one option)

- Tasks, docs, goals, dashboards and automation
- Works across marketing, sales, operations and product
- Generous free starting option
- Can become complicated if over-customized

Website: [ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Show your team how to organize, track and manage work in Notion](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eDhnRWP5InpUJ42HXdgd1UR36J9QbxHhNmul_BC9oZI6HtTw9TTlnhrMgoJuzPFTbry5Cb1czp8p7XUFHHegKOCFK0T1TF00gxNIn9ci1ArY8pfhwDB9a1YROBGcyzMZFNl0bNq4Yvj3C3UqI3EelzYT7aXrSRIZpy5PleNnOPDo2TPY9fV1dJEVpdbFdRlG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Great for early-stage teams
- Combines documentation, company wiki and tasks
- Useful for organizing ideas and business plans
- Requires more setup to create structured workflows

Website: [Notion](https://notion.so/)

---

![Introducing Status for remote work • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent for cross-functional teams
- Clear project ownership and deadlines
- Good reporting and project dependencies
- Particularly useful as teams grow

Website: [Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Monday.com Review: Visual Work OS for Marketing & Operations | Jira Alternatives](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/76NvYecSF06ssUogqo92ldlBp0kbpk_hgvezPK97KNjZsZ3UwqQeEGBDsMXGcEq0Qe1Z60tjx_JOghoppOd40Ca5wV9fHT6K4OeUAHjck9gcZqw0bmf3n4nK_EIBfikbehoXTAQ2U9KTTEhfvX7yOoreYkOZ0zBZztd8pFx71UOVpyBTMt5YWObff0h0jS0W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Excellent visual dashboards
- Good for marketing, sales and operations
- Strong workflow automation
- Easy for nontechnical teams to adopt

Website: [Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 people, early stage | Notion |
| 5–20 people, tech startup | Linear + Notion |
| 5–30 people, mixed departments | ClickUp |
| 20–50 people, growing business | Asana |
| Operations-heavy startup | Monday.com |
